sourceConflicts: The active instructions say Enter the organization's UEI, the DAT classifies SAM UEI as pre-populated, and the XFA leaves it editable in some application contexts. The canonical declaration preserves SGG prepopulation but makes no unconditional read-only claim.
The instructions call the Assistance Listing number and title required while the DAT and XSD make both optional. This audit does not resolve that separate cardinality conflict.

The DAT names the Funding Opportunity Title source SubmissionDef.OpportunityIDTitle while the XFA calculate event uses SubmissionDef.OpportunityTitle. The SGG target binding is retained without silently equating the two source names.
operationalEvidenceBoundary: Do not derive operationalBehaviorEvidence from prepopulation annotations. The DAT supports prepopulation, XFA supports editability findings, and SAM UEI remains context-dependent. Any future operational record must preserve exact evidence for every asserted facet.
parityClaim: The declaration preserves six SGG prepopulation bindings and removes six unsupported unconditional read-only assertions. It does not resolve application-context editability, Assistance Listing cardinality, or the Funding Opportunity Title source-name discrepancy.
